en.title: Kazakhstan's transition from commodity corridor to investable Eurasian infrastructure platform
en.deck: Financed rail expansion, power reform and new Asian resource partnerships are beginning to connect Kazakhstan's commodity base to logistics, processing and private capital.
en.regime: Infrastructure-led diversification under persistent inflation and a large state footprint
en.key_risk: Private capital may lag public infrastructure if inflation, quasi-fiscal activity or investor-state disputes remain elevated.

pt-BR.title: A transição do Cazaquistão de corredor de commodities para plataforma eurasiática de infraestrutura e investimento
pt-BR.deck: Expansão ferroviária financiada, reforma elétrica e novas parcerias asiáticas em recursos começam a conectar a base de commodities do Cazaquistão a logística, processamento e capital privado.
pt-BR.regime: Diversificação liderada por infraestrutura sob inflação persistente e grande presença estatal
pt-BR.key_risk: O capital privado pode ficar atrás da infraestrutura pública se inflação, atividade parafiscal ou disputas investidor-Estado permanecerem elevadas.

selection_rationale: Material financed rail and power investment is converging with market and utility reforms and new Korean agreements in nuclear energy, oil, critical minerals and technology. The transition is less covered than its potential effect on Eurasian trade, resource processing and private-capital mobilisation, and the transmission mechanisms run through transport costs, electricity capacity, investment conditions and household real incomes.
